aiResearchSummary.text: Cohesity is researching and developing technologies for efficient backup, restore, and management of data across distributed and cloud environments. Efforts include distributed journals for high performance continuous data protection, adaptive deduplication, parallelization of incremental backups, efficient data retrieval using embeddings, and snapshot archive management. Additional focus areas are anomaly detection before backup, hierarchical storage management, and secure communications for storage tenants, highlighting advancements in data protection, storage optimization, and analytics.
